recommendation: Keep the audit commit as-is. No further FHIR core work is needed for FHIR-29663; any broader refresh of the UCUM common example value set should proceed under a separate vocabulary decision.
issue_request: FHIR-29663 was a Published/Persuasive FHIR-core vocabulary change request for R5 asking to replace the UCUM common ValueSet code `{kp_C}` with `[kp_C]` because the R4 value set contained an invalid expression for the intended homeopathic potency unit.
initial_application: Commit 0c94343a04a2ae99f2e071fb983bf663cce7af5c (`fhir-36010 + fhir-29663`) changed `source/valueset/valueset-ucum-common.xml` from `{kp_C}` to `[kp_C]`; current R5 history also contains `[kp_C]` while older R4/R4B history retains `{kp_C}`.
additional_context: The current source still has `[kp_C]`, and `source/ucum-essence.xml` contains the matching UCUM unit code. `ValueSet` is active in `source/fhir.ini`, and `source/valueset/list-ValueSet-examples.xml` references `ValueSet/ucum-common`, confirming build scope. Vocabulary WG minutes from 2021-06-10 confirm the issue was persuasive and the code needed changing, while broader value-set currency concerns were deferred.
reconciliation: No source change was needed. An empty audit commit records that the approved correction is already present in current source.

related_jiras.note: Applied in the same historical commit but addresses adding a unity code to UCUM value sets, not the `[kp_C]` correction.
